p4_real_gaps.why: 0.103 m is the unloaded P1 v2 torus equator; the loaded radius of the real wheel is not measured
the proxy uses a CYLINDER r=0.103, not the crowned toroidal tread, so the contact patch and pressure distribution are wrong
16 kg chassis + 1 kg/wheel are TEST_PROXY values; no vendor mass data (P4-02 only proves the proxy is self-consistent)
0.2 / 0.8 / 1.4 are arbitrary gear values on the ground material, not measured tyre-road coefficients
joint velocity targets, no torque/current limit, no back-EMF, no battery sag, no thermal derating
joint state is read at the physics rate with no encoder quantisation, noise or communication delay
the chassis speed fed back to the trim is identically zero (see D1); a real loop needs a live measurement
only flat straight-line and turn cases were run
the stop test only shows that a zero command decays; there is no E-stop hardware or safety relay
the closed-loop runs log a stale 0 target, so the applied wheel command is not in raw_poses.jsonl
